name_input: LIEBHERR INDIA PVT. LTD.; LIEBHERR INDIA PVT LTD; M/S LIEBHERR INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED; LIEBHERR INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED
court_cases: Confirmed litigation in Calcutta High Court (commercial/arbitration matters), all civil-commercial, no criminal element found. Party role: Liebherr India is claimant/petitioner in several proceedings and respondent in others. Key records (indiankanoon.org): (1) Liebherr India Pvt Ltd vs Emta Coal Ltd, Calcutta HC, orders 14 Aug 2018 (Justice Ashis Kumar Chakraborty, A.P. No. 613 of 2019 line of matters); (2) Liebherr India Private Limited vs Emta Coal Limited, 16 Dec 2019 (A.K. Chakraborty); (3) Liebherr India Private Limited vs Emta Coal Limited, 2 Mar 2021, AP/421/2020 (Justice Debangsu Basak); (4) Liebherr India Private Limited vs Emta Coal Limited And Ors, 20 May 2022 and 28 Jul 2022, AP/186/2022 and EC/234/2022 (Justice Shekhar B. Saraf); (5) Emta Coal Limited And Anr vs Liebherr India Private Ltd. And Ors, 19 Jun 2023 (Justice Moushumi Bhattacharya) - here Liebherr is the respondent. Nature: arbitration-petition / execution / appointment-of-arbitrator and interim-measure proceedings arising from a commercial supply dispute with Emta Coal; AI tags on Indian Kanoon classify them as 'appointment-of-arbitrators', 'arbitration', 'interim-measures'. Status: orders passed at various stages; no final judgment located in the search results, so current status of each proceeding is not public in the pages read. Also: Liebherr India Private Limited & Anr vs State Of West Bengal, Calcutta HC, 12 Jun 2017 (Justice Debangsu Basak) - writ/state-authority matter, outcome not read. Total 163 Indian Kanoon hits for 'Liebherr India' and 15 for 'Liebherr Emta Coal arbitration'; only the above were reviewed. Per project rule 2, these are noted neutrally and are not rejection grounds.
note: Research constrained: DuckDuckGo/searx backend returned connection refused, Google returned a redirect stub, DuckDuckGo HTML endpoint closed the connection; only Bing and Indian Kanoon were usable. SANCTIONS: no hit found, but this is NOT a clean negative screen. The OFAC SDN/Non-SDN consolidated CSV was retrieved (last updated 23/11/2026) but truncated at 6000 chars, so a keyword match on 'Liebherr' could not be executed; the OFAC Sanctions List Search tool requires interactive form submission and returned only its landing page. UN Consolidated List, EU consolidated list, UK OFSI list and the BIS Entity List were not queried at all. sanctions_hit is therefore null = not verified, not 'clear'. Note as context only: the Liebherr group is a German-Swiss manufacturer; no listing of the Indian entity was observed in any source read. COURT CASES: see court_cases field - documented civil-commercial/arbitration litigation with Emta Coal in Calcutta High Court, plus a 2017 State of West Bengal matter. No criminal proceedings, no NCLT/insolvency proceedings, no owner-level criminal matters found in the sources read. RATING: null - no CRISIL/ICRA/CARE/India Ratings/Acuite rating for Liebherr India Private Limited was located; searches were blocked, so absence is unverified rather than confirmed. NEWS RISK: null - no negative news (regulatory action, penalty, product recall, fraud allegation) was located, but news search was effectively unavailable, so this is an unverified null, not a clean bill. RF/CIS SUPPLY: null - no evidence found of supplies by the Indian entity to Russia or the CIS. The Russian-language query returned only generic Liebherr group corporate pages with no shipment, contract or customs reference. No B-L, customs record or contract naming Liebherr India Private Limited as supplier to a Russian/CIS consignee was found. This is 'no evidence found', not 'evidence of absence'. Per project rule 5, nothing here should be read as confirmation of any supply activity in either direction. Scope note: per role instructions I did not research legal identity, HS codes or shipment volumes; the claimed HS 847160 (IT/electronics) is inconsistent with Liebherr's actual construction/mining/aerospace machinery business, but HS correction is outside my remit and is not a rejection ground under rule 3. Recommendation: keep the company; re-run the OFAC/UN/EU/UK/BIS screens and a credit-rating lookup when search access is restored, since all three of those fields are currently unverified nulls.
